ops.loadingHours: Packages for the venue should be sent to "Arcadia Ichigaya, Procurement Section" (4-2-25 Kudan-kita, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 102-0073), with the banquet or meeting name and the event date written on them. Cash-on-delivery is not accepted for accommodation-related packages. Use of the venue, from setup to teardown, must be completed within the contracted time, and an extension fee is charged if the set time is exceeded. If load-in and load-out for setup and the like fall outside the time slots in the price list (morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-16:30 / evening 17:30-21:00), a separate usage fee is charged. (Terms revised April 1, 2021)
ops.vehicleRules: The road in front of the hall is a no-parking zone. Microbuses and large buses cannot enter the parking lot.
ops.parking: Underground parking lot operated by Times24 Co., Ltd. (named "Times Arcadia Ichigaya Shigaku Kaikan"). Open 7:00-23:00; the shutter is closed from 23:00 to 7:00 the next day and vehicles cannot enter or leave. Height limit 2.1 m. The fee is 330 yen (tax included) per 15 minutes. The maximum fee and the discount for hall users are given in the official PDF (August 2026 version). There is no parking space for motorcycles.
ops.catering: Outside food and drink may not be brought in. Signs, decorations, additional power supply, additional lighting, music, entertainment, companions and the like are in principle arranged by the hall through its designated vendors. If you use a vendor other than the designated ones, you must notify the hall in advance and hold a meeting, and a corkage/bring-in fee may be charged depending on the content.
ops.restaurants: The restaurant floor on the 2nd floor has 4 outlets: the French restaurant Fossé, the Chinese restaurant Sui, the Edomae eel restaurant Unasei, and the lounge Cerisaie.
